data_verification_workflow.step_1: Fetch raw events from Setlist.fm (Source of Truth for dates)
data_verification_workflow.step_2: Cross-reference with Wikipedia API using 'Tour Name' or 'Artist + Year'
data_verification_workflow.step_3: If Wikipedia match found: Update Title, Poster, and Tag to JOINT/FESTIVAL
data_verification_workflow.step_4: If no Wikipedia match: Keep as SHOWCASE/TOUR based on internal logic

logic.JOINT: Artists >= 2 AND Has Tour Title AND Same Venue
logic.FESTIVAL: Artists >= 2 AND No Tour Title AND Same Venue (Grouped by Date/Venue)
logic.VARIETY: Artists >= 2 AND No Tour Title AND Venue is Stadium/Dome/Arena

poster_logic.uniqueness: Same artist in different years must pull different posters if applicable

features.search: Instant search by Title and all_artists
features.filtering: Dropdown filter by five tags (TOUR, JOINT, FESTIVAL, SHOWCASE, VARIETY)

card_display.multi_artist_label: Display '多組藝人出演' for JOINT, FESTIVAL, VARIETY
card_display.tag_styling: All-caps text with CSS classes matching .tag-{lowercase_tag}

interaction.dropdown_logic: Show session-dropdown only for TOUR and JOINT
interaction.realtime_update: Date, Venue, and Google Maps URL must update instantly upon dropdown change

content_rendering.artist_list_format: Strictly Bullet Points (• Name). No slashes or commas.
content_rendering.festival_layout: Group by Day (Day 1, Day 2...) with bulleted artists for FESTIVAL and VARIETY

technical_guardrails.css_compatibility: Dynamic HTML must use predefined IDs: #artist-list, #session-dropdown, #tag-display
technical_guardrails.data_storage: Single aggregated data.json keyed by Title
technical_guardrails.url_handling: All venue names must use encodeURIComponent for Map links
